data.narrative:
Floodbase is a Series A climate & energy company founded by Bessie Schwarz and Dr. Beth Tellman, having raised $17M to date. The comparable universe includes 9 private-sector peers in Climate & Energy (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and 1 public company (LNZA). However, no peers in the narrow same-stage or adjacent-stage cohort exist with sufficient overlap in valuation tier, limiting peer-median triangulation.

Stage-progression methodology applies a 2.0x multiplier to the $17M capital raised proxy, implied by typical Series A to next-stage advancement benchmarks. This single applicable method yields a point estimate of $34M.

The triangulated valuation range is $29M (low), $34M (median), and $39M (high). This range reflects a narrow analytical base grounded in a single method; applicability relies on the assumption that stage-progression multiples hold for Floodbase's risk and sector profile. The primary uncertainty stems from absence of granular peer comparables at identical stage and valuation tier, precluding cross-check via market multiples. Resolution would require either identification of additional Series A climate-tech comparables or forward-looking revenue or unit economics data to anchor relative value.
